feature: Cooperative reader startup and cancellable native simulator loading
checks: Startup hashes at most one 8192-byte chunk or indexes one page per step
Restored source position, bookmarks, page count, and rendered pixels match synchronous construction
Document parse errors are deferred until hashing finishes
Native Escape event cancels hashing even when the press is shorter than a frame
Cancellation preserves saved state byte-for-byte and reopening succeeds
Existing native navigation, typography, library, links, and previews still pass
limitations: Metadata/chapter parsing, font loading, state loading, and library scanning remain synchronous
A page step is not a wall-clock latency bound
The final simulator key-event fix received separate native and Clippy validation after the workspace run began; shared controller source was unchanged during that run
